hypotheses.title: Batch 89: Unmined Factor Frontiers & Structural Yield Sprint
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Deploys three genuinely unmined, structurally distinct empirical phenomena that have zero overlap with any approved alpha in the portfolio: (1) Candidate 1: Enterprise Revenue Yield & Top-Line Sales Acceleration in analyst4, measuring gross receipts yield relative to trailing 1-year distribution and sales momentum. (2) Candidate 2: Funds From Operations (FFO) to Long-Term Debt Solvency Coverage (fnd6_fopo / debt_lt), isolating cash-generative firms with zero default risk. (3) Candidate 3: Options Volatility Risk Premium Term Contango, longing 1-year institutional LEAP call IV relative to Parkinson realized volatility while shorting noisy 30-day mean IV. All candidates use distinct 2-factor rank combinations, 100% unit-clean, and strictly avoid signed_power or price delta hedges.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if top-line revenue yield, debt coverage solvency, or LEAP call term contango fail to produce Sharpe >= 1.25 and Fitness >= 1.50 under subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Enterprise Revenue Yield & Top-Line Sales Acceleration): Top-line sales cannot be manipulated by accounting accruals or aggressive capitalization. This alpha longs companies trading at historically cheap enterprise revenue yields over their 1-year history with positive 2-quarter sales growth. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

candidates.expression: group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd6_fopo, 60) / (ts_backfill(debt_lt, 60) + close * 100), 252), subindustry) + 0.50 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(fnd6_fopo, 60) / close, 180), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Candidate 2 (Operating Cash Solvency & Long-Term Debt Coverage): Based on structural credit risk models (Merton 1974), longing companies with high operating cash flow (FFO) coverage of long-term debt liabilities and high cash yields. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 5.

Candidate 3 (1-Year LEAP Call Option Term Contango): Harvests the volatility risk premium where institutions systematically overpay for 1-year tail protection relative to Parkinson realized volatility, while fading noisy 30-day mean implied volatility. Evaluated in TOP1000 Subindustry Neutral with Decay 6.
